mapper.select: SELECT v.*, p.question_text, p.explanation FROM videos v LEFT JOIN problems p ON v.problem_id = p.problem_id WHERE v.video_id = #{videoId}
SELECT * FROM videos WHERE problem_id = #{problemId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO videos (problem_id, title, subject, video_type, video_url, cdn_url, thumbnail_url, subtitle_url, duration_sec, file_size_mb, school_id, grade, level, unit_name, view_count, is_active, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{title}, #{subject}, #{videoType}, #{videoUrl}, #{cdnUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{subtitleUrl}, #{durationSec}, #{fileSizeMb}, #{schoolId}, #{grade}, #{level}, #{unitName}, 0, COALESCE(#{isActive}, 1), #{uploadedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE videos SET title = #{title}, subject = #{subject}, level = #{level}, unit_name = #{unitName}, video_url = #{videoUrl}, cdn_url = #{cdnUrl}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, is_active = COALESCE(#{isActive}, is_active), updated_at = NOW() WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
UPDATE videos SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
UPDATE videos SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
UPDATE videos SET is_active = NOT is_active, updated_at = NOW() WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
